body.justification: The explicit primitive-game modulus controls values and certified rules, while the nonstandard two-sided experiment-equivalence premise, separate almost-sure legality and numerical boundedness, and joint total-variation premise control every bounded endpoint loss; multiplicity and active-face changes therefore do not invalidate the conditional feasible transfer.
body.gap: Theorem 3 of MontielOleaQiuStoye2026Local gives the feasible fully differentiable rule, while Assumption 5 and Theorem 5 give feasible transfer for its directionally differentiable centrosymmetric rule. HiranoPorter2009 motivates pointwise limit-experiment treatment-rule analysis but does not supply the compact-\(H\), two-sided total-variation equivalence or the joint approximation with an estimated game assumed here. The present theorem conditionally treats the non-centrosymmetric polyhedral class and quantifies perturbation error uniformly over saddle and indexability ties; FangSantos2019 and FirpoGalvaoParker2023 explain why pointwise plug-in reasoning alone is insufficient at such nonsmooth boundaries.
body.consumer: Researchers estimating covariance and bound derivatives obtain a feasible treatment rule whose regret guarantee remains valid near face and indexability boundaries.
